llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文专注于SLM Ti-6Al-4V的表面粗糙度表征，与生物医学植入物的表面形貌和骨整合相关，但未涉及应力遮挡或力学性能。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses solely on surface roughness characterization of as-built SLM Ti-6Al-4V and does not address porous structures, stress shielding, mechanical testing (static or fatigue), or osseointegration.

summary_en.motivation: To characterize the surface roughness of selective laser melted Ti-6Al-4V alloy components for biomedical applications.
summary_en.method: Experimental measurement of surface roughness under varying process parameters using contact and non-contact profilometry.
summary_en.result: Process parameters such as laser power and scan speed significantly influence surface roughness, with optimal ranges identified.
summary_en.validation: Surface roughness measurements were validated via multiple profilometric techniques and compared with literature data.
